slots.claim_sentence: Many decisions are thought to arise from the accumulation of noisy evidence until it reaches a threshold.
slots.clarification_sentence: This theory is known as the bounded evidence accumulation model.

slots.claim_sentence: In perception, this mechanism explains how stimulus strength affects decision speed, accuracy, and confidence.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stimulus strength is often characterized by the signal-to-noise ratio.

slots.claim_sentence: Bounded evidence accumulation models paradoxically predict that an increase in noise should lead to higher confidence.
slots.clarification_sentence: The models also predict that increased noise leads to faster decisions.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers introduced a sensory manipulation that mimics the addition of unbiased noise to the visual cortex.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers verified this manipulation with recordings from macaque areas MT/MST.

slots.claim_sentence: In both humans and monkeys, increasing the noise induced faster decisions and greater confidence.
slots.clarification_sentence: These effects occurred over a range of stimuli for which accuracy was minimally impaired.

slots.claim_sentence: The magnitude of the effects was in agreement with predictions of a bounded evidence accumulation model.
slots.clarification_sentence: A single model accounted for the combined effects of motion strength and volatility on choice.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used a random dot motion display to increase stimulus volatility without changing motion strength.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method allowed the team to test how noise alone influences the decision process.

slots.claim_sentence: Monkeys indicated confidence by waiving a sure bet option for a riskier choice during the trials.
slots.clarification_sentence: The proportion of riskier choices was greater on the high volatility trials.

slots.claim_sentence: The Shigella flexneri enzyme OspI modifies the host protein UBC13 by changing glutamine to glutamate.
slots.clarification_sentence: Shigella flexneri is a pathogen that causes severe diarrhea by invading the human intestine.

slots.claim_sentence: The modification of UBC13 prevents it from working with the protein TRAF6.
slots.clarification_sentence: This blockage stops the NF-κB inflammatory response and silences the immune system alarm.

slots.claim_sentence: The chemical change in UBC13 prevents it from physically binding to the TRAF6 RING-domain.
slots.clarification_sentence: This loss of interaction occurs even though the overall shape of UBC13 remains stable.

slots.claim_sentence: The modification creates a new intramolecular salt-bridge that competes with the normal connection point.
slots.clarification_sentence: Proteins often stick together using electrical attraction between positive and negative charges.

slots.claim_sentence: The new negative charge on UBC13 also pushes away the negatively charged surface of TRAF6.
slots.clarification_sentence: This electrostatic repulsion further prevents the two proteins from coming together properly.

slots.claim_sentence: This study shows how small chemical changes can disrupt the brief contacts proteins must make.
slots.clarification_sentence: Such post-translational modifications can inhibit protein-protein association by perturbing these transient complexes.

slots.claim_sentence: Understanding these subtle molecular tricks could help in developing new drugs to treat bacterial infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: The work reveals the exact mechanism Shigella uses to dampen its host immune response.

slots.claim_sentence: Normally, these proteins trigger chemical signals that attract immune cells to clear the infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The bacterial enzyme inhibits the synthesis of polyubiquitin chains by the UBC13 and TRAF6 complex.

slots.claim_sentence: Working memory depends on large-scale interactions between different brain networks.
slots.clarification_sentence: This memory allows people to hold and use information for short periods.

slots.claim_sentence: Synchronized brain activity helps coordinate long-range processes for working memory.
slots.clarification_sentence: These rhythms often occur in the theta range between 4 and 8 Hz.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used tACS to modulate rhythms in the right frontoparietal network.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study applied 6 Hz stimulation to healthy volunteers during memory tasks.

slots.claim_sentence: Synchronous stimulation improved performance when the cognitive demands were high.
slots.clarification_sentence: Participants showed faster reaction times during the difficult 2-back memory task.

slots.claim_sentence: The effects of tACS depend on the internal cognitive state of the participant.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists used fMRI scans to monitor brain activity during the electrical stimulation.

slots.claim_sentence: Synchronous tACS increased parietal activity which correlated with better task performance.
slots.clarification_sentence: Higher activity in the parietal region led to faster responses from the volunteers.

slots.claim_sentence: The stimulation phase influences the flow of information within the memory network.
slots.clarification_sentence: Altering phase synchrony helps control how distant brain regions interact with each other.

slots.claim_sentence: The study shows a causal link between brain synchronization and memory performance.
slots.clarification_sentence: Large-scale synchronization is essential for completing demanding mental tasks successfully.

slots.claim_sentence: The stimulation targeted the middle frontal gyrus and inferior parietal lobule.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specific brain regions are part of the right frontoparietal network.

slots.claim_sentence: The granular retrosplenial cortex is essential for navigation, learning, and memory.
slots.clarification_sentence: This brain region is also known as the RSG.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used optogenetic circuit mapping in mice to study the RSG.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method uses light pulses to activate specific brain cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Spatial information from the anterior thalamus is processed by unique low-rheobase neurons.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specialized cells are called LR neurons for short.

slots.claim_sentence: Non-spatial information from the claustrum is processed by regular-spiking cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These regular-spiking cells are also known as RS cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Parallel processing is enabled by the precise overlap of axons and dendrites.
slots.clarification_sentence: This physical layout occurs in the uppermost layer 1 of the RSG.

slots.claim_sentence: LR neurons can calculate the speed of head rotation from direction inputs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This calculation depends on the behavior of connections called synaptic dynamics.

slots.claim_sentence: These unique neurons are specialized to support spatial orientation and navigation.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cells combine direction and speed to help animals find their way.

slots.claim_sentence: The RSG is critical for both spatial and non-spatial behaviors.
slots.clarification_sentence: Damage to this area can cause a loss of direction.

slots.claim_sentence: LR cells are a unique type of excitable cell not found elsewhere.
slots.clarification_sentence: The dendrites of LR cells reach into areas containing spatial input axons.

slots.claim_sentence: The brain uses different cell types for different types of data.
slots.clarification_sentence: Standard neurons in the same area handle different types of information.

slots.claim_sentence: Stable flower shapes provide a reliable cue for pollinators and are robust to natural variation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Consistent petal numbers help ensure that insects can easily recognize and visit the flowers.

slots.claim_sentence: The research plant Arabidopsis thaliana consistently produces flowers with exactly four petals.
slots.clarification_sentence: This four-petal count remains robust even when the plants have different genetic backgrounds.

slots.claim_sentence: The related species Cardamine hirsuta lacks this robustness and has zero to four petals.
slots.clarification_sentence: This variation means the petal number in Cardamine hirsuta is unpredictable compared to its relative.

slots.claim_sentence: The APETALA1 gene is a major factor in the evolutionary transition between these species.
slots.clarification_sentence: Differences in this single gene, also called AP1, explain why petal numbers vary.

slots.claim_sentence: The Arabidopsis version of AP1 maintains a constant petal number by masking other genetic variations.
slots.clarification_sentence: This masking prevents quantitative trait loci, or QTL, from changing the final petal count.

slots.claim_sentence: Changes in regulatory regions of the AP1 gene cause the divergence in petal number.
slots.clarification_sentence: These differences occur in the gene switches rather than in the protein coding regions.

slots.claim_sentence: Variable petal number is maintained in Cardamine hirsuta despite having genetic variation for four petals.
slots.clarification_sentence: The change in the AP1 gene allows this variation to persist in natural populations.

slots.claim_sentence: Physical trauma, disease, and aging can damage the digestive tract and cause gastrointestinal pathologies.
slots.clarification_sentence: Understanding how the gut repairs itself is important for treating these human health issues.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used laser-capture microdissection and RNA-seq to study the flatworm Schmidtea mediterranea.
slots.clarification_sentence: This flatworm is a powerful model because it can regrow its entire gut after injury.

slots.claim_sentence: The team identified over 1,800 transcripts that are enriched in the planarian intestine.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transcripts are molecules that show which genes are active in a specific tissue.

slots.claim_sentence: This sensitive method identified 809 transcripts that single-cell RNA-Seq studies did not find.
slots.clarification_sentence: Bulk tissue profiling proved more sensitive than previous techniques for detecting these hidden genes.

slots.claim_sentence: The planarian intestine transcriptome shows high similarity to human tissues like the small intestine.
slots.clarification_sentence: The flatworm gut uses genes for metabolism and innate immunity similar to human organs.

slots.claim_sentence: Gene expression in the flatworm intestine varies along the mediolateral axis of the body.
slots.clarification_sentence: Specific genes are active in either the medial or lateral branches of the gut.

slots.claim_sentence: Specialized cells called goblet cells show different gene patterns based on their location.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding suggests that goblet cells have different roles depending on where they reside.

slots.claim_sentence: The transcription factor gli-1 regulates the regeneration of these important goblet cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Another factor called RREB2 is necessary for the maintenance and survival of these cells.

slots.claim_sentence: The planarian intestinal transcriptome serves as a foundational resource for studying organ regeneration.
slots.clarification_sentence: This map helps scientists understand the physiology and repair of complex digestive systems.

slots.claim_sentence: Mitochondria require mechanisms to recognize and remove misfolded proteins to maintain essential functions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mitochondria are essential to cellular bioenergetics and metabolism.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used temperature-sensitive proteins in yeast as model substrates for mitochondrial quality control.
slots.clarification_sentence: Saccharomyces cerevisiae was used as the model organism to study protein degradation.

slots.claim_sentence: Misfolded mitochondrial proteins are degraded by the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
slots.clarification_sentence: The degradation of these proteins is dependent on the 26S proteasome.

slots.claim_sentence: Specific ubiquitin ligases, Ubr1 and San1, mediate the ubiquitination of these proteins.
slots.clarification_sentence: These ligases are required to degrade the mitochondrial temperature-sensitive substrates.

slots.claim_sentence: Mitochondria-associated degradation requires the SSA family of Hsp70 and the Hsp40 chaperone Sis1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This provides the first evidence for chaperone involvement in this degradation pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: The degradation process involves the Cdc48-Npl4-Ufd1 complex and a mitochondrial pool of Ubx2.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein Ubx2 has a discrete and functional pool located at the mitochondria.

slots.claim_sentence: This mitochondrial quality control pathway is unique and distinct from other cellular pathways.
slots.clarification_sentence: The pathway uses a combination of cytosolic and mitochondrial factors.

slots.claim_sentence: Mitochondrial-associated degradation is distinct from the endoplasmic reticulum-associated degradation pathway.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study identifies a unique pathway comprised of specific cellular factors.

slots.claim_sentence: The degradation of mitochondrial outer membrane proteins also involves the factor Doa1.

slots.claim_sentence: MicroRNAs are small molecules that help control how genes work in the body.
slots.clarification_sentence: One specific molecule called miR-9 is very common in the brain and neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: The role of miR-9 in dendritic and synaptic development was previously unknown.
slots.clarification_sentence: Dendrites are tree-like branches that help neurons connect with each other.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers created a transgenic sponge mouse line to inactivate the miR-9 family.
slots.clarification_sentence: This sponge mouse allows scientists to turn off the molecule in specific tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: The study found that miR-9 controls dendritic growth and synaptic transmission.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neurons in the hippocampus showed reduced branch length when miR-9 was missing.

slots.claim_sentence: Lowering the transcriptional repressor REST is essential for proper dendritic growth.
slots.clarification_sentence: The miR-9 molecule ensures REST levels stay low as neurons mature.

slots.claim_sentence: The REST protein is upregulated in neurons that express the miR-9 sponge.
slots.clarification_sentence: High levels of this repressor protein prevent the branches from growing correctly.

slots.claim_sentence: Synaptic transmission was significantly reduced in mice lacking the miR-9 molecule.
slots.clarification_sentence: This reduction shows that the molecule is vital for brain cell communication.

slots.claim_sentence: Scientists observed high miR-9 activity in both neurons and astrocytes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Astrocytes are another type of important cell found within the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: Vector-borne disease transmission is predicted to peak at intermediate temperatures and decline at high and low temperatures.
slots.clarification_sentence: Both low and high temperatures limit transmission due to low mosquito fecundity and survival at all life stages.

slots.claim_sentence: Ross River virus is a significant mosquito-borne pathogen found in Australia and the Pacific Islands.
slots.clarification_sentence: This virus has the potential to emerge globally and causes debilitating joint pain in thousands of people.

slots.claim_sentence: The researchers used a mechanistic model to determine the relative influence of temperature on transmission potential.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers used fecundity and survival data from experimental mosquito populations to fit these thermal response models.

slots.claim_sentence: Transmission of Ross River virus peaks at a moderate temperature of 26.4°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: This specific temperature represents the optimal point for the virus to spread most effectively through mosquito populations.

slots.claim_sentence: The thermal limits for Ross River virus transmission are 17.0°C and 31.5°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: Beyond these specific thermal limits, the transmission of the virus declines to zero.

slots.claim_sentence: Ross River virus transmission is endemic year-round in tropical regions but occurs seasonally in temperate areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: In tropical northern Australia, the temperature remains suitable for the virus throughout the entire year.

slots.claim_sentence: Climate warming is expected to increase Ross River virus transmission in temperate areas of Australia.
slots.clarification_sentence: Warming may decrease transmission in tropical areas where temperatures are already near the thermal optimum.

slots.claim_sentence: Characterizing nonlinear thermal responses is more accurate for predicting disease variation than assuming transmission simply increases with temperature.
slots.clarification_sentence: These nonlinear models are particularly important for predicting how transmission will change under future climate regimes.

slots.claim_sentence: The motor cortex produces brain waves called beta oscillations during movement control.
slots.clarification_sentence: The specific behavioral correlates of these brain waves remain unresolved in neuroscience.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers trained three macaque monkeys to perform a neurofeedback arm-reaching task.
slots.clarification_sentence: The monkeys used electrodes to control their brain signals during the task.

slots.claim_sentence: The monkeys volitionally controlled their beta oscillatory power before an arm reach.
slots.clarification_sentence: The animals moved a cursor on a screen by changing their brain waves.

slots.claim_sentence: A reduction in beta power led to faster movement onset times.
slots.clarification_sentence: An increase in beta power caused the monkeys to start moving slower.

slots.claim_sentence: Population neural activity shifts farther from a movement onset state during oscillations.
slots.clarification_sentence: High beta levels push the brain away from the state needed to move.

slots.claim_sentence: The study establishes a population neural basis for slowed movement onset.
slots.clarification_sentence: These results show that beta frequencies are a marker of movement delays.

slots.claim_sentence: This explains why people with Parkinson's disease often struggle to start movements.
slots.clarification_sentence: Patients with this condition often exhibit high levels of beta waves.

slots.claim_sentence: The brain must reach a specific threshold of activity to trigger a movement.
slots.clarification_sentence: Beta waves seem to push the brain away from this starting line.

slots.claim_sentence: Some viruses like Marburg and Dengue benefit from the activation of a protein called Nrf2.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nrf2 is a protein that normally helps cells turn on anti-oxidant genes to protect themselves.

slots.claim_sentence: Sulforaphane is a natural product found in cruciferous vegetables that activates the regulator Nrf2.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sulforaphane is produced in vegetables like broccoli and cabbage when they are damaged or chewed.

slots.claim_sentence: Sulforaphane blocks HIV infection in primary human macrophages but does not block infection in T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Macrophages and T cells are both types of immune cells that the virus can infect.

slots.claim_sentence: The depletion of Nrf2 using siRNA boosted HIV infectivity and reduced the effects of Sulforaphane.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used a technique called siRNA to remove Nrf2 from cells to test its protection.

slots.claim_sentence: The anti-viral activity against HIV is mediated through Nrf2 after it is mobilized by Sulforaphane.
slots.clarification_sentence: This confirms that Sulforaphane works by triggering the cell's own defense system against the virus.

slots.claim_sentence: Sulforaphane treatment blocks infection after entry but before the formation of 2-LTR circles.
slots.clarification_sentence: The virus enters the cell but is stopped before it can finish preparing its genetic material.

slots.claim_sentence: The known anti-viral proteins SAMHD1 and MX2 were not upregulated during this process.
slots.clarification_sentence: Usually the body uses these specific proteins to fight HIV but Nrf2 uses a different method.

slots.claim_sentence: Sulforaphane and other Nrf2 stimulators could potentially be used as therapeutic agents to block HIV.
slots.clarification_sentence: This discovery suggests that common dietary supplements could be developed into a novel treatment for HIV.

slots.claim_sentence: The Dominican Republic experienced a Zika outbreak immediately following a large dengue epidemic.
slots.clarification_sentence: This sequence allowed researchers to compare the transmission drivers of these two viruses.

slots.claim_sentence: Approximately 75% of dengue cases occurred in people under the age of 20.
slots.clarification_sentence: In contrast, only 42% of Zika cases occurred in that same young age group.

slots.claim_sentence: Zika infection rates were significantly higher among females at 73.8% of reported cases.
slots.clarification_sentence: Males accounted for only 26.2% of the total Zika infections recorded during the study.

slots.claim_sentence: Guillain-Barre syndrome attack rates were slightly higher in males than in females.
slots.clarification_sentence: This syndrome is a serious neurological complication that can occur after a viral infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Existing population-level dengue immunity had little impact on the reported Zika attack rates.
slots.clarification_sentence: Prior exposure to the dengue virus did not seem to change how Zika spread.

slots.claim_sentence: Higher reporting among women of reproductive age likely stems from health-seeking behavior.
slots.clarification_sentence: Community awareness campaigns influenced this behavior more than biological differences between the sexes.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers recommend media campaigns and screening for women of reproductive age during outbreaks.
slots.clarification_sentence: These targeted efforts help ensure that high-risk groups receive necessary medical attention and monitoring.

slots.claim_sentence: Anabaena filaments develop nitrogen-fixing heterocysts when they face nitrogen deprivation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Anabaena is a multicellular cyanobacterium that grows in long chains or filaments.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used a fluorescent hetR-gfp fusion to track the HetR protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: HetR is a transcription factor essential for the development of heterocysts.

slots.claim_sentence: Fluctuations in hetR expression are coupled between nearby cells in a filament.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coupling occurs over a spatial range of two to three cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Correlations between cells arise primarily from intercellular molecular transfer.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cells communicate by passing regulatory molecules through physical connections.

slots.claim_sentence: The proteins PatS and SepJ determine fluctuations under nitrogen-rich conditions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Positive HetR auto-regulation also helps control how these fluctuations are distributed.

slots.claim_sentence: The final developmental pattern is built upon pre-existing spatial correlations.
slots.clarification_sentence: These correlations exist as a foundation before nitrogen deprivation begins.

slots.claim_sentence: Organisms use cell-cell communication to control noise in gene expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: Controlling this stochasticity helps cells avoid making incorrect cell fate decisions.

slots.claim_sentence: Heterocysts are separated by approximately ten photosynthetic vegetative cells in the filament.
slots.clarification_sentence: Vegetative cells continue to perform photosynthesis while heterocysts provide fixed nitrogen.

slots.claim_sentence: Molecular transfer is more important for these correlations than cell division.
slots.clarification_sentence: Direct transport between neighbors creates the observed spatial patterns of gene activity.

slots.claim_sentence: Humans can learn and store multiple visuomotor mappings through a process called dual-adaptation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This ability allows people to adjust their movements when environmental conditions change.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants performed a target-pointing task by tapping a graphics tablet to hit shapes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers manipulated the visual feedback to shift the hit location away from the shape.

slots.claim_sentence: The target shapes were morphed on a continuous scale between spiky and circular.
slots.clarification_sentence: These shapes ranged from very spiky to completely round to test learning rules.

slots.claim_sentence: A Bayesian learning model describes how humans combine sensory feedback with prior experiences.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model uses a Mixture-of-Kalman-Filters to update beliefs in a statistically optimal way.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants apply the mapping for the trained shape most similar to the current one.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process requires conscious awareness of the role each shape plays as a cue.

slots.claim_sentence: The learning speed decreases as the number of training pairs increases.
slots.clarification_sentence: Different shapes can cause interference during the learning process due to local generalization.

slots.claim_sentence: The Bayesian model provides a mechanism for simultaneously learning multiple visuomotor mappings.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model explains how humans store and use different movement skills at once.

slots.claim_sentence: Many countries lack the baseline data needed for planning disease elimination programs.
slots.clarification_sentence: Without this data, these countries cannot scale up health programs effectively.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed the Integrated Threshold Mapping methodology to map four diseases simultaneously.
slots.clarification_sentence: This ITM method tracks trachoma, schistosomiasis, lymphatic filariasis, and soil-transmitted helminths.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology determines if a threshold for public health interventions is reached.
slots.clarification_sentence: A country must show a disease threshold is surpassed before launching drug administration.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM protocol was tested against standard WHO mapping methodologies in Mali and Senegal.
slots.clarification_sentence: Testing occurred in one district within each of these two countries.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as WHO methods for most diseases.
slots.clarification_sentence: However, the new protocol provided more targeted intervention recommendations for schistosomiasis.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology resulted in a 31% cost savings in Mali.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protocol also saved 19% in costs and took half as much time.

slots.claim_sentence: This integrated mapping tool could facilitate program implementation in endemic countries.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mapping sets the stage for all following integrated health program activities.

slots.claim_sentence: Neglected tropical diseases cause significant physical debilitation and lowered economic productivity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Resource constraints in endemic countries have impeded progress toward elimination goals.

slots.claim_sentence: Organ aging is associated with a reduction in the number of stem cells occupying their specialized niche.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stem cells live in specialized environments called niches that support their survival and function.

slots.claim_sentence: In Drosophila female germline stem cells, Notch signaling levels increase as the organism ages.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers studied fruit flies to understand how this specific communication pathway changes over time.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch signaling regulates the adhesion of germline stem cells to the niche by controlling E-cadherin expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: E-cadherin acts like a glue that helps stem cells stick to their niche.

slots.claim_sentence: The loss of germline stem cells from the niche is partially mediated by the gene Sex lethal.
slots.clarification_sentence: A protein called Sex lethal helps control the Notch signal in these stem cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch signaling in the niche cells, which maintains niche integrity, decreases with age.
slots.clarification_sentence: Notch signaling was decreased in the niche but increased in the stem cells themselves.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings regarding Notch signaling and cell adhesion may be relevant to metastatic cancer cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: In metastatic cancer, Notch signaling also suppresses cell adhesion to help cancer cells spread.

slots.claim_sentence: HIV infection currently cannot be cured but can be controlled using combinations of multiple anti-retroviral drugs.
slots.clarification_sentence: These anti-retroviral drugs work together to manage the virus within the body.

slots.claim_sentence: Because HIV genotypes vary between individual patients, it is difficult to determine which drug combination will be effective.
slots.clarification_sentence: Effective treatment must be tailored to the specific viral genotype of each person.

slots.claim_sentence: Existing HIV drug resistance models typically rely only on sequence data and do not account for chemical similarity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ignoring the chemical similarity of drugs means these models discard valuable information.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers applied proteochemometric models that combine chemical properties of drugs and protein target properties into one model.
slots.clarification_sentence: This technique is called PCM modeling and explicitly considers how drugs interact with their targets.

slots.claim_sentence: The proteochemometric models outperformed previous sequence-only models in resistance classification and predicting viral response levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: The prediction error improved by approximately 11% compared to models using only viral sequence data.

slots.claim_sentence: Staphylococcus aureus uses cell wall-anchored proteins to invade host tissues and evade the immune system.
slots.clarification_sentence: These surface proteins help the bacteria stick to and enter host cells while avoiding natural defenses.

slots.claim_sentence: The protein clumping factor B helps Staphylococcus aureus live inside the human nose.
slots.clarification_sentence: This protein is also known as ClfB and facilitates colonization by interacting with the nasal lining.

slots.claim_sentence: ClfB determines the structure of skin abscesses and the amount of bacteria during early infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein achieves this by binding to a specific skin protein called loricrin within the tissue.

slots.claim_sentence: A model vaccine targeting ClfB provides protection against Staphylococcus aureus skin infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: This vaccine triggers both humoral and cellular immune responses to fight the bacterial infection.

slots.claim_sentence: ClfB is an important antigen for the development of future vaccines against skin infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: These skin and soft tissue infections are commonly referred to by the medical term SSTI.

slots.claim_sentence: Mice given the ClfB vaccine developed significantly smaller abscess lesions during the study.
slots.clarification_sentence: The reduction in lesion size confirms that the vaccine helps control the severity of infection.

slots.claim_sentence: The interaction between ClfB and loricrin is essential for the bacteria to establish skin infections.
slots.clarification_sentence: Without this specific binding, the bacteria cannot easily form organized clusters in the skin.

slots.claim_sentence: Dengue virus is the most common arbovirus causing 100 million symptomatic infections annually.
slots.clarification_sentence: This virus is spread by mosquitoes and affects millions of people every year.

slots.claim_sentence: Infections range from mild dengue fever to life-threatening dengue hemorrhagic fever.
slots.clarification_sentence: Dengue hemorrhagic fever is a severe form that causes dangerous internal bleeding.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used mass spectrometry-based metabolomic profiling to analyze patient blood sera.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method identifies small molecules called metabolites during the critical phase of illness.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified 29 metabolites that were differentially expressed between the two groups.
slots.clarification_sentence: These chemical markers help distinguish between mild and severe forms of the disease.

slots.claim_sentence: Bile acids were 5 fold higher in severe cases and correlated with liver injury.
slots.clarification_sentence: High levels of liver enzymes like AST and ALT confirmed this organ damage.

slots.claim_sentence: Uric acid was 1.5 fold lower in severe patients, which increases oxidative stress.
slots.clarification_sentence: Lower levels of this antioxidant reduce the body's ability to protect its cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Elevated chenodeoxyglycocholic acid persisted into the recovery phase for severe patients.
slots.clarification_sentence: This indicates that the virus has a prolonged adverse impact on the liver.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings provide insights into pathogenesis and suggest new therapeutic targets for management.
slots.clarification_sentence: Understanding these chemical changes helps doctors find new ways to treat severe dengue.

slots.claim_sentence: Cullin-RING ubiquitin ligases must have their substrate receptor subunits tightly controlled.
slots.clarification_sentence: This control ensures the cell maintains a balanced repertoire of these enzymes.

slots.claim_sentence: Misregulation of substrate receptor components in SCF ligases is associated with cancer.
slots.clarification_sentence: SCF ligases represent the largest class of these protein-tagging enzymes.

slots.claim_sentence: F-box proteins are typically regulated by autocatalytic ubiquitylation within an intact SCF complex.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process allows the complex to break down its own receptor parts.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified a new degradation pathway for the yeast F-box protein Met30.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway acts on Met30 when it is dissociated from the Skp1 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: The newly discovered Met30 degradation pathway requires the cullin component Cdc53/Cul1.
slots.clarification_sentence: Surprisingly, this specific destruction process is entirely independent of Skp1.

slots.claim_sentence: The non-canonical Met30 degradation pathway is essential for maintaining chromosome stability.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway also provides an effective cellular defense against heavy metal stress.

slots.claim_sentence: The study assigns biological functions to a sub-complex consisting of Cdc53/Rbx1/Cdc34.
slots.clarification_sentence: This sub-complex performs its tasks without needing the Skp1 component.

slots.claim_sentence: Cells cannot properly handle toxic cadmium when this backup destruction pathway fails.
Rapid degradation of F-box proteins maintains a critical level of unoccupied core complexes.
